title: Rules for the night porter at the Alder Court 🏨
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: You have been hired as the night porter at a hotel with one empty floor.

scenes.narration: You have been hired as the night porter at a hotel with one empty floor. Read these rules before you start.
Rule one. The hotel has eight floors. Guests may only ask for floors one to seven. If someone asks for eight, say it is closed for cleaning.
Rule two. At two in the morning, the corridor lights on floor eight will switch on by themselves. Do not go and turn them off.
Rule three. If you hear a trolley on eight, it is the cleaner. You do not have a cleaner on nights. Do not speak to the cleaner.
Rule four. Room eight hundred and four has a guest. The guest has been in the room since before the hotel was built. Do not knock.
Rule five. If room eight hundred and four rings the front desk, answer on the third ring, and only say, how can I help.
Tonight at two the phone rang. Three rings. I answered. A calm voice said, I would like my floor back. It was reading from the rulebook, in my voice.
There is a sixth rule, written in pencil under the desk. Rule six. The night porter is the guest in eight hundred and four.
So tell me. Do you take the lift to floor eight, or hand in your keys?

overlays.text: GO UP  or  HAND IN KEYS
